transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

Hi Doctor! I’m here because I’ve been feeling this absolutely incredible, unstoppable surge of energy and just an extremely elevated, happy mood for the last five months. It’s like I’m on top of the world and my mind is buzzing so fast that I just can't seem to slow down!
Have you had any experiences like hearing or seeing things other people don’t, or strong beliefs that others say are not true?

Yes, I've definitely heard whispering voices and seen things that others can't see, especially when my energy is through the roof. I also get these strong feelings that I have special, unique powers and that people are watching or targeting me, which my family says isn't real. These experiences only seem to happen during these high-energy periods when my mind is racing.
